gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants who have the appearance of high-grade glioma (HGG, WHO Grade 3 and 4, including GBM) on MR imaging are allowed to consent and will undergo the procedure if the frozen is consistent with HGG

candidate_evidence.quote: Each participant will undergo intraoperative electrocorticography (ECOG) through subdural grid (SDG) and depth electrode (DE) via FDA-cleared, standardized, brain recording technology.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants with a history of histologically-confirmed diagnosis of high- grade glioma that are undergoing resection of a recurrent/progressive tumor that is likely recurrent/progressive high- grade glioma as identified on preoperative MR imaging

source_quote.quote: Electrical activity will be assessed as described above and correlated with transcriptomic changes.

coder_notes: Surgical/electrophysiology recording study with no drug or biologic interventions (procedures only). Eligible population: newly diagnosed-appearing HGG (WHO grade 3 and 4, including GBM) or recurrent HGG; GBM named in conditions and inclusion. cns5_terminology historical because 'WHO Grade 3 and 4' HGG is used without IDH requirement; unclear would be an alternative.
